object_description: compact six-story solitary school building with ring plan
design_condition: The compact solitary building occupies a strong urban position opposite the existing vocational center, leaving generous open spaces around it within a continuous landscaped campus.

positive.statement: The building is positioned strongly and confidently in a good urban and strategic location.
The three volumes communicate over greater distances and develop an exciting structural dialogue.
The compact design generates a small footprint and generous open spaces on all sides.
The height development is considered possible in relation to the surrounding area.
The ring-shaped arrangement creates an impressive and exciting spatial figure with carved air spaces.
The structural concept and materialization appear well thought out, harmonious, and atmospheric inside the building.
The serial structure is expected to be very cost-effective, with key values in the lower range.
The attitude of using as little land as possible is appreciated.
The differentiated and generous outdoor-space concept interacts well with the building.
The bridge extends the existing access axis and leads to a generous space between the school and sports hall.
The riverbank is treated with beautifully differentiated stairs.

negative.statement: The aisle zones and sanitary areas are too small, and the vertical access concept is not entirely coherent.
The development of building technology and sustainability requires further emphasis.
The expansion option is only sketched schematically and a second school building would weaken the concept and reduce the quality of the open parking space.
The quality of the landscape project suffers somewhat from the natural design of the southern edge and the building's proximity to the roundabout.
